teaser: The Web Summit chasm made us zoom in to one thing: a £50 Sovereign Website, only possible because of the layers under it.
core_idea: A startup needs one small, cheap first thing to buy; the Sovereign Website is that thing, and it is only possible because behaviour policies, signed decisions, keys and a site factory make many agents safe and fast together.
